Value addition & benefit

One bridge, value on both sides.

LabourersWork comes to you
  • No more waiting for work. Jobs near your village on your phone, WhatsApp or a phone call.
  • Picked for your skills. Tomato picking, spraying, tractor driving get matched first.
  • Wage known before you travel. Set your rate, bid, accept only a fair price.
  • Regular work, steadier income. Fewer idle days, less dependence on middlemen.

Goal 10–15% more job opportunities in every village across Nashik.

EmployersHire without leaving the farm
  • Find labour from home. Post a job in minutes, no trips to search.
  • Skilled workers, close by. Ranked by skill, village and availability.
  • Ready for peak season. Book a crew days before harvest or spraying.
  • Price fixed, booking confirmed. Fewer last-minute cancellations, less time managing labour.

Solution

Field survey · Mom Test

We asked about last month, not opinions.

38 labourers and 42 farmers surveyed across Nashik district · 8–16 Oct 2026. Farmers asked for 398 workers in total.

ता
Mom Test call · farm labourerTanaji Morajkar, Kokangaon
  • Stayed home ~15 days last month for lack of work; May is the leanest month.
  • Work comes straight from farmers, not a mukadam.
  • Tomato picking pays ₹600–800 a day, enough to run the house.
  • Paid in cash or online; sometimes the next day, but reliably.
  • Farmers cover travel when work is outside the village.

Farmers: how they'd rather book labour

  • WhatsApp only 45%
  • WhatsApp or app, either 43%
  • App only 2%
  • Phone call / not sure 10%

Comfortable booking on WhatsApp or an app

Phone call 66%WhatsApp 34%

But 2 in 3 labourers still prefer offers by phone call → WhatsApp + IVR.

How labourers got their last job

  • Mukadam 50%
  • Personal contacts 18%
  • Farmer directly 13%
  • Naka, phone, WA group 19%

Half depend on a middleman to find work.

Farmers: biggest problem finding labour

Labour not found on time83%
Not enough workers36%
Wages asked too high33%
Last-minute no-shows24%
No skilled workers24%

% of 42 farmers · more than one answer allowed. 83% want pay beyond daily wage (per acre, per crate, fixed).

Labourers: biggest problem finding work

No info on nearby work34%
Work not regular29%
Wages too low21%
Transport, late pay, other16%

% of 38 labourers. Median minimum wage asked: ₹650/day; 70% find work the same day.

Tech side · matching and data processing

From messy inputs to the right match.

01 · COLLECT

Every channel

App forms, WhatsApp replies, IVR key presses, Google Form imports

02 · CLEAN

One record per person

De-duplicate by mobile number; map Marathi and English skill names; village to location

03 · SCORE

Match score

Skill fit, distance, availability, wage fit, reliability

04 · NOTIFY

Ranked list

Top matches alerted by app, WhatsApp or IVR

05 · LEARN

Feedback loop

Bookings, cancellations and ratings improve the next match

Revenue model

We earn when work happens.

01

Service charge

On every confirmed booking, paid by the employer on top of the wage.

02

Membership

Subscription for regular employers, with a discount on the service charge.

03

Referral points

Users earn points for bringing others in, lowering what it costs us to grow.

On booking

Farmer pays wage + service charge into the KaamSetu wallet.

Farmer cancels

Amount refunded, service charge deducted.

Labourer cancels

Labourer's wallet goes minus by the service charge.
